title: Add trust_tier and default it from MemoryOrigin at write time
summary: The column EPIC-32 is blocked on: a 0-3 trust level set automatically by which write path produced the row.
description:
Add `trust_tier SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 1` to all five memory tables (migration 0011) and to the models. Default at write time from `MemoryOrigin`: DIRECT_WRITE and EXTRACTION -> 1 (OBSERVED); CONSOLIDATION, RECONCILIATION, and INGEST_RESOLVER -> inherit the *minimum* tier across their source records, which requires STOR-2's edges and is the reason this story sits after it.

Minimum rather than maximum is the safe direction and is worth stating explicitly: a conclusion drawn partly from a quarantined source is itself quarantined, because trust does not launder through inference.

Acceptance: every write path sets a tier and none leaves the default implicitly; a consolidation over a tier-0 source and a tier-2 source produces a tier-0 derived record, covered by a live-Db2 test; the column is present on all five tables with no NULLs after migration. This story adds the column and the defaulting only — the `min_trust` read filter is GOV-1 and promotion policy is GOV-2, both in EPIC-32. Depends on STOR-2.
